diff.description: The revision payload. With "diff-match-patch" it is a patch against parentRevision. With "full-text" it is the note's whole new body, and it is only accepted when parentRevision is the current head.

blobs.description: Blobs the content references. Each is identified by the uploading repo's DID and the blob CID. Content points at one with ![alt](/blob/<did>/<cid>), the path lichen serves it from. Listing the ref here keeps the blob alive in the PDS.

title.description: Renames the note from this revision on. A revision that leaves it out keeps the title.

status.description: Set to "deleted" to take the note out of its wiki, keeping its history, and to "live" to restore it. A revision without it keeps the status.

message.description: Optional commit message describing this revision.

noteRef.description: AT-URI of the parent note record.

diffFormat.description: How to read the diff field. "diff-match-patch" means a patch against parentRevision. "full-text" means the whole note body.

parentRevision.description: AT-URI of the previous revision. Omitted for the first revision of a note.

main.description: A revision to a note. It holds either a diff from the previous revision or the complete new body, depending on diffFormat.
